crisis.title: Management Crisis
crisis.desc: Draft a team. The board sets a goal. Every two months a crisis card changes everything.
crisis.chooseMode: Choose a mode for your run

cap-boost.title: Cap Boost
cap-boost.effect: Sign 1 of 3 quality free agents for your lowest-rated player. Owner pays.

hot-streak.title: Hot Streak
hot-streak.effect: +3 team rating for the next 10 games.

rookie-gem.title: Rookie Gem
rookie-gem.effect: Pick 1 of 3 young prospects to replace your lowest-rated player.

veteran-mentor.title: Veteran Mentor
veteran-mentor.flavor: A grizzled vet wants one more ring.
veteran-mentor.effect: Pick 1 of 3 veterans for your weakest bench spot. Owner pays.

locker-room-glue.title: Locker Room Glue
locker-room-glue.effect: +1 team rating for the rest of the season.

clean-bill.title: Clean Bill of Health
clean-bill.effect: All your injured players are healed.

media-frenzy.title: Media Frenzy
media-frenzy.flavor: Ticket sales are tanking. The owner wants a celebrity.
media-frenzy.effect: Sign 1 of 5 high-profile stars and send out any one of your players.

blow-it-up.title: Blow It Up
blow-it-up.effect: Your best player is traded for the league's top young prospect.

trade-demand.title: Trade Demand
trade-demand.effect: Pick 1 of 3 lower-rated replacements at his position.

injury-bug.title: Injury Bug
injury-bug.effect: Your two heaviest-minute players are out 15 and 8 games.

coach-fired.title: Coach Fired
coach-fired.effect: −3 team rating for 10 games, then +1 for the rest of the season.

luxury-tax.title: Luxury Tax Panic
luxury-tax.effect: Swap your highest-paid player for 1 of 3 players at least $10M cheaper.

locker-room-drama.title: Locker Room Drama
locker-room-drama.flavor: Your best bench player is causing problems.
locker-room-drama.effect: Choose: −2 team rating for 15 games, or trade him for a minimum-salary player.

superteam-rumor.title: Superteam Rumor
superteam-rumor.flavor: A superstar wants to join you.
superteam-rumor.effect: Choose: sign a 95+ star and lose your two highest-paid starters, or decline.

legend-comeback.title: Legend Comeback
legend-comeback.flavor: An all-time great laces them up again.
legend-comeback.effect: Pick 1 of 3 legends (90+) for your weakest bench spot.

midseason-miracle.title: Midseason Miracle
midseason-miracle.effect: +4 team rating for the next 15 games.

career.title: Career
career.desc: One franchise, many seasons. Aging, contracts, drafts and free agency, until the board fires you.

career.f1Body: Draft, re-sign, trade and develop one team, season after season.
career.f2Body: The board sets a goal every year. Miss too often and you are fired.
career.f3Body: Titles, a Hall of Fame and franchise records that last.

gauntlet.desc: Beat 10 great teams in a row with your card lineup. Best-of-3 each.
gauntlet.lost: Eliminated {{w}}-{{l}}. Tweak your lineup and try again.

card.levelHint: Each duplicate adds a level (+1 rating, up to +3).

welcome.b1: Spin for a team, pick a player, and fit ten under a $200M cap. Only two 95+ stars allowed.
welcome.b2: Injuries, a trade deadline and a seven-game playoff run. 70 wins is rare. 82-0 is a myth.
welcome.b3: Every run earns a Player Pick. Build a card lineup and take on the Gauntlet.

friends.title: Friends
friends.shareText:
Add me on Ten Deep! My PIN is {{pin}}. Tap to add me and duel my team:
{{link}}

friends.pinHint: Your PIN goes online the first time you open the app with a connection.
friends.invalid: That code didn't work. Ask your friend to share it again.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Share your code, add theirs, and start a rivalry.
friends.clashDesc: Your card lineup vs theirs. Pick the series length.
friends.finalsDesc: Your last drafted team vs theirs, best of 7 for the ring.
friends.raceDesc: Same spins for both of you. More wins takes it; playoff depth breaks ties.
friends.raceNote: Finish, then share your result: when {{name}} plays your link, it counts for both of you.
friends.needLineup: Set up your card lineup first
friends.theirNoLineup: {{name}} hasn't set a card lineup yet
friends.stale: Their team is from their last shared code ({{day}}). Ask for a fresh one to update it.
friends.couchDesc: One phone, two coaches: alternate picks, then a best-of-7.

friends.notFound: No player with that PIN yet. Ask them to open the Duels tab while online.
friends.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, or paste their link instead.

shop.title: Shop
shop.what: A reroll spins the wheel again when you don't like where it landed, once your 2 free respins are used.
shop.adNote: Rewarded video ads go live with the App Store and Google Play release.
shop.soon: Purchases open when Ten Deep launches on the App Store and Google Play. Nothing is charged here.
shop.earn: Free rerolls also come from your daily login.
shop.fair: No loot boxes: everything for sale shows exactly what you get.
shop.notHere: Rerolls are off in the Daily Draft and races: same spins for everyone.

party.tagline: Draft together. Play one shared season.

party.f3Body: Watch your teams battle in one shared league.

Join my Ten Deep party! Room code {{code}}

account.body: Sign in to keep your progress, cards and friends on every device.
